description: What the agent_results suite must notice about the rename: the reader of a task saved without a record (lib/agent-results.mjs splitVerificationNotice) stops finding the sentence an earlier Hub wrote ("ChatMCP has NOT ..."), or the one the Hub writes now ("DatGold has NOT ...").

mutations.name: R1
mutations.what: the reader looks only for the current wording (a task saved before the rename keeps the Hub's sentence inside the model's claim)

mutations.name: R2
mutations.what: the reader looks only for the wording before the rename (a task saved by this Hub keeps the Hub's sentence inside the model's claim)

mutations.name: R3
mutations.what: the notice that is reported is always the current wording, even when the text ends with the earlier one

patches.old: return { text: finalText.slice(0, -(VERIFICATION_NOTICE_MARK + standing).length), notice: standing };
patches.new: return { text: finalText.slice(0, -(VERIFICATION_NOTICE_MARK + standing).length), notice: wordings[0] };
